enonce.texte:
Read the following news article and answer the questions that follow.

Yaoundé, Cameroon

The Minister of Education has announced new reforms for secondary schools. These reforms include the introduction of technology in classrooms and new teacher training programs. The Minister said that these changes will improve the quality of education in the country. Many parents have expressed their support for the reforms. However, some teachers are concerned about the lack of resources. The government has promised to provide the necessary equipment and training within the next six months. The Minister also mentioned that the reforms will be implemented gradually over the next two years.

questions.texte: What has the Minister of Education announced?
questions.reponse: He has announced new reforms for secondary schools.

questions.texte: What do the reforms include?
questions.reponse: They include the introduction of technology in classrooms and new teacher training programs.

questions.texte: What is the reaction of parents?
questions.reponse: Many parents have expressed their support for the reforms.

questions.texte: Why are some teachers concerned?
questions.reponse: They are concerned about the lack of resources.

questions.texte: What has the government promised?
questions.reponse: The government has promised to provide the necessary equipment and training within the next six months.

questions.texte: Summarize the article in three sentences.
questions.reponse: The Minister of Education has announced new reforms for secondary schools, including technology and teacher training. Parents support the reforms, but teachers worry about resources. The government will provide equipment and training over the next six months, and reforms will be implemented over two years.

enonce.texte:
You listened to a podcast about climate change in Africa. Based on the following summary, answer the questions.

Podcast Summary: Climate Change in Africa

The podcast discusses how climate change is affecting agriculture in Africa. Many farmers are experiencing unpredictable weather patterns. This has led to lower crop yields and food shortages. The podcast also highlights innovative solutions such as drought-resistant crops and improved irrigation systems. Experts agree that urgent action is needed to support farmers.

questions.texte: What is the main topic of the podcast?
questions.reponse: The main topic is climate change in Africa and its effect on agriculture.

questions.texte: What problems are farmers facing?
questions.reponse: Farmers are facing unpredictable weather patterns, lower crop yields, and food shortages.

questions.texte: What solutions are mentioned in the podcast?
questions.reponse: Solutions mentioned include drought-resistant crops and improved irrigation systems.

questions.texte: What do experts believe?
questions.reponse: Experts believe that urgent action is needed to support farmers.
